snippet.title: BERSERK EMBLEM - A Fire Emblem fan game ~by TomLeggosaurus
snippet.description:
SERENES FOREST LINK HERE: https://forums.serenesforest.net/index.php?/topic/95738-fe8-berserk-emblem-ver-10/
Please go to the Serenes Forest link to download and for more information.

This has been a project LONG in the making. Working on and off for about 3 years. I set a hard goal to release it before the end of the year, so while it's a little rushed and incomplete in places, I was determined to hit my target!!

Please share it with any Berserk or FE fans you know!

Also I am not an editor... this trailer is made purely for function, not style hahaha.


***** I should probably mention somewhere just in case, I have no current plans to work on this further. Apologies if you were excited for more updates, I just have other things on my plate now.

Also find me in these places!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tomleggosaurus/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TomLeggosaurus
